title: Sales By Representative exports name the Sales Type selection
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Open Reports > Sales By Representative in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. With all Sales Types selected, export the PDF and read the filter line at the top.
  2. Export the CSV and read the filter line at the top.
  3. Select only Parts and Part Sales in the Sales Type filter.
  4. Export the PDF and read the filter line.
  5. Export the CSV and read the filter line.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • It reads "Sales Type: All".

Step 2:

  • It reads "Sales Type: All".

Step 3:

  • Only Parts and Part Sales are ticked.

Step 4:

  • It reads "Sales Type: Parts, Part Sales".

Step 5:

  • It reads "Sales Type: Parts, Part Sales".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • S8-R4: “The filter line at the top of every PDF and CSV export of Sales By Representative reads the same: "Sales Type: All", or the selected names. With no option selected there is nothing to export: Export shows "Empty export" and makes no file. Any other export with no rows, for example a date range with no invoices, still downloads a file with the headings and no rows, as today.”
